marie_csm: Heads-up — CardinalRx (CRX-91) renewal moved to HIGH risk. Usage collapsed ~71% over 10 days; procurement is running a competitive eval with OrbitalAI. Champion (Priya) transitioned out last week. :alarm:

zoe_support: Oof. Any breakdown by feature or route?

marie_csm: Quick slice from analytics:```
-- daily summary last 10d
SELECT day, total_requests, batch_jobs, embed_calls
FROM customer_daily
WHERE customer_id='CRX-91'
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 10;
-- total_requests: 22k -> 6.3k in 10 days; batch_jobs almost zero
```

dan_renewal: Procurement already asked for a price comparison vs OrbitalAI yesterday. They want committed vs hosted cost and risk notes. I'm prepping the commercial bridge options.

ravi_eng: Checking their infra: alerts-bot, show recent deploys/errors for CRX-91.

alerts-bot: deploys: last_deploy=2026-03-08T22:07Z; errors: spike on /batch/submit on 2026-03-11 (x4 baseline) with 502s; KV cache evictions at ~03:00 daily since 2026-03-10; CPU throttling observed on sidecar around same window.

ravi_eng: Thanks. Sounds like nightly batch window is failing (sidecar OOM/timeout). Might be recent config tweak or token rotation. Can we get last successful job id + app logs?

marie_csm: I emailed the known contacts but the champion left slack. New ML lead is apparently on maternity leave; procurement directed to a tech PM (Jordan). Zoe — can you do a soft outreach to Jordan and ask for a 30m troubleshooting call? Invite Ravi.

zoe_support: On it. I'll ping now with a short note: "we're seeing your nightly scoring fail and want to help restore jobs before your QBR".

ravi_eng: To buy time with procurement, propose a 2-week pilot on our quantized variant (lower cost) + a remediation plan: we can run a canary that uses lighter batch footprints and show cost/day. If OrbitalAI pricing is the risk, this often neutralizes procurement.

dan_renewal: Sales will sign-off on a pilot incentive if CS can confirm the expected cost delta. Ravi — can you estimate GPU-hours for a trimmed nightly batch (target ~8k items) and a canary throughput? Need numbers for TCO slide.

ravi_eng: Rough estimate: trimmed nightly for 8k items on q4-bit variant ~0.25-0.35 GPU-hours/day using our small GPU profile. Full fidelity nightly (20k) on baseline quantization ~0.9-1.1 GPU-hours/day. I'll firm up and post later today.

marie_csm: Proposed customer-facing options: 1) Immediate troubleshooting call + restore batch (CS+Eng) 2) 2-week quantized canary pilot at a discounted rate 3) Exec QBR offer w/ 6-week paid extension to align on roadmap and renew. Recommend we lead with 1+2 and hold QBR as escalation.

dan_renewal: Agreed. I'll draft a short procurement note with these options and include a competitive TCO appendix.

marie_csm: Action items: (A) Zoe to schedule troubleshooting call (today). (B) Ravi to deliver GPU-hour estimates + quick remediation checklist (EOD). (C) Dan to draft commercial bridge + TCO slides (tomorrow). (D) Marie to monitor usage and prepare a short exec summary if we don't see stabilization within 72h.

alerts-bot: monitor set: customer=CRX-91, alert_if_drop>20% day-over-day, notify=#customer-alerts.

zoe_support: Call scheduled with Jordan for 2026-03-19 15:00 UTC. Inviting Ravi and Marie.

ravi_eng: Posted initial postmortem checklist in thread: reproduce failure locally, pull last job id, check sidecar memory limits, validate token rotation window, inspect KV eviction policy. Will update with numbers.

marie_csm: If we can get their nightly scoring back within 48h, renewal risk often flips from HIGH -> MEDIUM. Let's hustle. :white_check_mark:
